root_cause.text: The ocfs2_fault() function retains a pointer to the vm_area_struct (vma) across a call to filemap_fault(), which may drop mmap_lock and allow a concurrent munmap() to free the vma, leading to a use-after-free when the trace event later dereferences the dangling pointer.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description and patch commit message explicitly state: "filemap_fault() may drop the mmap_lock before returning VM_FAULT_RETRY... When this happens, a concurrent munmap() can call remove_vma() and free the vm_area_struct via RCU. The saved 'vma' pointer in ocfs2_fault() then becomes a dangling pointer, and the subsequent trace_ocfs2_fault() call dereferences it -- a use-after-free." The patch fix removes the vma parameter from the trace event and saves ip_blkno as a plain integer before the call to filemap_fault().

candidates.rationale: Function definition where the vulnerable vma pointer is captured and used across a call that may drop mmap_lock.
Stores a pointer to vma from vmf, which becomes dangling after filemap_fault may drop mmap_lock and allow munmap.
Call that may drop mmap_lock, allowing concurrent munmap to free the vma referenced by the local vma pointer.
First part of trace call that dereferences vma->vm_file -> ... after the vma may have been freed, causing use-after-free.
Second part of trace call that passes the dangling vma pointer as argument, leading to use-after-free when the trace event accesses it.
Return statement that concludes the vulnerable function; though not directly causing the issue, it is part of the sequence where the dangling pointer is still in scope.

vuln_statements.explanation: Stores a pointer to the vma from vmf, which becomes a dangling pointer after filemap_fault() may drop mmap_lock and allow concurrent munmap() to free the vma.
Call to filemap_fault() that may drop mmap_lock, allowing a concurrent munmap() to free the vma referenced by the local vma pointer, making it dangling.
First part of trace call that dereferences the dangling vma pointer (through vma->vm_file->f_mapping->host), causing a use-after-free when the vma is freed.
Second part of trace call that passes the dangling vma pointer as an argument, leading to use-after-free when the trace event accesses the freed vma.
Function definition where the vulnerable vma pointer is captured from vmf->vma and used across a call that may drop mmap_lock, forming the context for the use-after-free.
Return statement that concludes the function; while not directly causing the use-after-free, it is part of the sequence where the dangling pointer remains in scope after the trace call.
